checks.name: Duplicate navigation and topic names are rejected before any click
An inspected expected href selects the topic instead of global navigation
A stale or wrong expected href never falls back to the first link
An explicit selector must still identify one visible control
Hidden duplicates do not displace the visible inspected control
Returned targets remain strict when a duplicate appears later
Inspected hrefs with encoded quotes and spaces are compared without selector injection
Credential and script destinations cannot be expected source hrefs
A unique role and name still resolves ordinary inspected buttons
Ambiguous summary text is rejected rather than choosing a FAQ

limitations: Original local fixtures, not full source-site interaction acceptance
Expected href must come from an inspected control; this helper does not certify navigation destinations or source licensing
